main_result.name: QFORM-TWO-BANK-COUPLED-INNOVATION-GRAM-IDENTITY-v1
main_result.statement_short: For an exact-rank-three near-coloop Parseval frame split into two transverse banks with G_J+G_K=I, the least-squares longitudinal innovations delta_J,delta_K and slope difference d=q_J-q_K satisfy exactly 1-h=delta_J^2+delta_K^2+d^T G_JG_K d.
main_result.structural_consequence: Both one-bank innovations and inter-bank slope separation can vanish simultaneously as h->1; no universal reciprocal lower-bound strategy based on these currencies can close the ultra-coloop endpoint.

target_witness: Five-coordinate Parseval frame with h=1, G_J=G_K=I/2, delta_J=delta_K=d=0 and Lambda=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] has spectrum {1,-1,1}; Q=2X0 L+V^2 remains inside the exact target.
latest_partner_application: Newest account02/B16 r36 fresh-hub theorem applied to the zero-currency witness gives ||p||_inf<=3*2^(4/3)=7.559526299... using the actual planar product-projection cap M<=2. More generally Q=2X0L+V^2+2L sum epsilon_j P_j on an arbitrary orthonormal leaf carrier has nonzero spectrum {1,+sqrt(1+||epsilon||^2),-sqrt(1+||epsilon||^2)} and the same <7.56 density bound despite dependence among leaf projections.
source_split_punctured_branch: For genuinely independent scalar banks H,L,V, Q_a=aH^2+2sqrt(1+a)HL+V^2 has spectrum {1+a,-1,1}; the prior three-disjoint-bank theorem gives ||p||_inf<=165.434001 uniformly for a>=0, including a downarrow0. Thus the remaining punctured issue is the square plus overlapping leaf provenance, not the square alone.

corrections_preserved: A bounded joint projection density or coordinate-marginal caps do not control an arbitrary indefinite curved trace.
No normalized conditional projection-height or worst-fiber shortcut.
Small random quadratic or longitudinal terms cannot be deleted on unbounded inputs.
The two one-bank innovation determinants and inter-bank slope separation are all charged to the same near-coloop defect 1-h and cannot be assumed order one.
next_implication: QFORM-PUNCTURED-FRESH-HUB-SQUARE-OVERLAP-STABILITY-v2: in 0<|a|D<2^-12 keep the untouched physical hub and original scalar factorization of the overlapping leaf bank, with a bound finite as both a->0 and h->1; do not invert delta_J, delta_K or ||q_J-q_K||.
